title: Document
description: Canonical published document entity produced by document-intelligence. Represents one logical document revision within a corpus.

document_revision.description: Monotonic canonical revision number for this document within the corpus.

processing_manifest_id.description: Immutable processing result that produced this canonical revision.

primary_artifact_id.description: Primary artifact chosen as the anchor for this document revision.

processed_at.description: Timestamp when this canonical revision became available.

processing_version.description: Version of the DI pipeline that produced the revision.

lifecycle_status.description: Document lifecycle state as exposed to downstream consumers.

full_text.description: Normalized full-document text, preserving material outside the main body where relevant.

body_text.description: Normalized body-only text intended for most retrieval and sectionization workflows.

metadata.description: Resolved canonical metadata and traceable low-risk metadata fields.

extensions.description: Non-canonical extension area for narrowly scoped downstream-compatible additions.
